summary: No new repository edits landed in this iteration; the work remained on the saved build/verification path. The strongest current signal is unchanged: an uncontended heartbeat-wrapped `vite build` run gets through SSR, enters the client build, starts materializing `.svelte-kit/output/client`, and then is terminated with exit code `137` before `build/` and the final preview manifest set are produced. That keeps the preview artifact contract incomplete, so the earlier services browse preview failure is still best explained by late build termination rather than a confirmed runtime regression in the services/task routes. The plan remains in the final verification tranche: complete one clean build deterministically, then rerun the bootstrap validator and the remaining targeted Playwright gates on the finished artifact set.
